samples.title: Establish a clean baseline from uncommitted work
samples.detail: Review the 28 unstaged files and either commit them with a descriptive message or stash them to create a clean, verifiable baseline before running checks.

samples.title: Run local checks against the current head and worktree
samples.detail: Execute npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm test, and npm run build to determine the actual current test and build status, since testResult is UNKNOWN.

samples.title: Reconcile documentation with the snapshot head
samples.detail: Compare README's 'not committed' UI-R1 claim and DEVELOPMENT.md's UI-R2 commit references against the actual current head f57fc770, then update docs to match reality before any future push.

samples.title: Verify palette and recognition scripts locally
samples.detail: Run npm run palettes:verify and npm run recognition:eval to confirm MARD data integrity and recognition behavior on the current code state.

samples.title: Audit AI and stock boundaries for implicit side effects
samples.detail: Review packages/ai-adapter integration points and stock/ledger transaction paths to ensure no UI or AI flow implicitly deducts stock, generates images, or bypasses idempotent transactions.

samples.title: Prepare for E2E validation if a clean baseline is established
samples.detail: After building, run npm run test:e2e against the built dist to validate browser regressions for the current UI work, using an existing Chromium if needed.

qualitativeFeedback.text: 感觉这几条建议都有些过于简短了，是你总结过了还是本来就这么短？我发现这些更偏向于我本地构建的建议，我想要的是核对项目发展、演进的这种建议。当然本地的这些建议也是可以有的，就是我希望建议更加的多元化。
qualitativeFeedback.assessment: 方向偏本地工程检查；需要项目发展与演进视角，保留必要工程建议，避免为多样性凑数。未逐条二元评分。
